d.ko: Yan, a student of natural history, encounters a cute and mysterious girl with fox ears while conducting routine scientific research at a remote observation cabin. This might be a "blessing" for the intrepid in the golden age of geographical discovery...
d.en: Yan, a student of natural history, encounters a cute and mysterious girl with fox ears while conducting routine scientific research at a remote observation cabin. This might be a "blessing" for the intrepid in the golden age of geographical discovery...
d.zh: 除了七大名著中的猫，也许你还会喜欢上狐狸。你是一位年轻的博物学科学生，在野外观察站中孤身一人从事乏味的科考活动时邂逅了一位头上长着兽耳的可爱又诡异的神秘女孩，你和她的故事或许就是这个波澜壮阔的地理大发现时代给予每位勇敢的探索者的“眷顾”吧……
